changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO emergency_trolley_unit (location_id,trolley_name,trolley_code,description,active,creator,date_created,voided,uuid) SELECT i.location_id,'Default Emergency Trolley','DEFAULT','Automatically created for existing trolley items',1,MIN(i.creator),MIN(i.date_created),0,UUID() FROM emergency_trolley_item i LEFT JOIN emergency_trolley_unit t ON t.location_id=i.location_id AND t.trolley_code='DEFAULT' AND t.voided=0 WHERE t.trolley_id IS NULL GROUP BY i.location_id
UPDATE emergency_trolley_item i JOIN emergency_trolley_unit t ON t.location_id=i.location_id AND t.trolley_code='DEFAULT' AND t.voided=0 SET i.trolley_id=t.trolley_id WHERE i.trolley_id IS NULL
